name: East End Dead Drop
description: A pre-war intelligence cache was hidden in East London before the bombs. Vex has the coordinates but can't retrieve it herself — the East End is crawling with a territorial gang called the Cinder Boys.

stages.name: Reach the East End
stages.description: Travel to the East London ruins where the dead drop was buried before the war.

stages.name: Deal with the Cinder Boys
stages.description: The Cinder Boys control the block. Neutralize the patrol or find a way to slip past them — the cache location is in their territory.

stages.name: Recover the Cache
stages.description: Find and dig up the buried intelligence cache from the marked location. Return the contents to Madame Vex.
